caption: cheerful children's nursery rhyme, bright ukulele, xylophone, hand claps, bouncy pop beat, 120 bpm, warm friendly female singer, clear simple English vocals, happy preschool song
lyrics:
[Verse]
Wiggle, wiggle, little Wigglo,
wiggle with me, here we go!
One big hop and two small hops,
wiggle, wiggle, never stops!

[Chorus]
One, two, three, four, five,
Wigglo dancing, so alive!
Clap your hands and stomp your feet,
wiggle, wiggle to the beat!

[Verse]
Bunny jumps and birdie sings,
flap, flap, flap your little wings!
Wiggle high and wiggle low,
wiggle, wiggle, Wigglo!

[Chorus]
One, two, three, four, five,
Wigglo dancing, so alive!
Clap your hands and stomp your feet,
wiggle, wiggle to the beat!
